articles.title: Alcaraz Wins Big After a Long Time Away
articles.summary: After four months out with a wrist injury, Carlos Alcaraz beat world number one Alexander Zverev in Turin to win his first ATP Finals title.

articles.title: A 12-Year-Old Fixes Old Toys for Kids in Need
articles.summary: When the Red Cross in North Carolina ran low on comfort toys, 12-year-old Sadie Hutson fixed 114 second-hand stuffed animals and gave them to children affected by disasters.

articles.title: Swimmer Ollie Morgan Is Winning Medals Again
articles.summary: After a challenging year of injuries, Ollie Morgan won five silver medals at the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow and is now targeting the World Aquatics Championships in China.
